name: condeig
expr: s_sym = condeig(A_sym); s_nrm = condeig(A_nrm); s_ill = condeig(A_ill);
comment: Sig: s = condeig(A). Eigenvalue condition numbers; s_i = 1/|cos(angle(v_i, w_i))| where v_i is right eigvec, w_i = inv(V)'s i-th column. Symmetric A → all s_i == 1 (perfectly conditioned). Non-symmetric → larger s_i flags ill-conditioned eigenvalues. Tol 1e-9 is loose because condeig values themselves can be large; we pin the structure (symmetric=1.0; non-sym pair has matching s_i; ill-cond is huge).
